phase: Candidate evidence; final review, final-head CI, merge and canonical completion still required
mechanism: Individually assessed already-prepared Windows players/launchers through existing execution-intent binding, explicit Play/relink and preserving registration removal
shared_boundaries: No upstream game, original, compiler, installer, updater/helper, private input or native Desktop execution. First-party owned probes remain separate from actual title/runtime/save acceptance.
Selected executable binding establishes execution intent, not original/companion authenticity or ownership of the external tree. Only the selected process is supervised.

Upstream/player owns original preparation, replacement, shared/custom data and recovery. Registration removal preserves external bytes. No external managed update/backup/rollback/migration/delete or Supported promotion.
Original/component terms and version-specific known limits stay individual. Four shared Athelas records do not inherit source, original, profile or acceptance from another title.
